The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of continuous venovenous hemodialysis (CVVHD) is associated with a lower incidence of AKI and mortality in patients with sepsis.
the use of continuous renal replacement therapy is associated with a higher mortality rate.
the use of continuous venovenous hemofiltration (CVVH) is a safe and feasible technique for the treatment of patients with AKI.
